ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; approximately 96% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels, with high-intensity pixels localized to small spots and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid dark field. Distinct high-contrast white circular spots are located in the inner right lobe near the notch, the mid-region of the left lobe, and the lower-right quadrant. Massive irregular high-contrast clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 78 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent serrations; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 4-15 pixels, with a higher frequency of jaggedness observed on the distal outer segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the primary trailing edge, terminating in complex, non-linear bulbous silhouettes at the distal tips due to biological accretion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 8 small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes. Significant, large-scale irregular clusters (barnacle colonies) are localized on the extreme left and right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and slightly diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) are detected: four prominent marks on the right lobe and two distinct marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) on the left and right distal tips; multiple linear rake marks across the ventral surface consistent with interspecific interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: The heavy, textured encrustation at the distal tips creates an atypical bulbous geometry that deviates significantly from the standard smooth fluke silhouette.
